description: This test file uses pytest and FastAPI's TestClient to test a FastAPI application, specifically testing API endpoints, request validation, and OpenAPI schema generation.

classes.name: TestClient
classes.description: A FastAPI testing client used to simulate requests to the API endpoints.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on the parameter and returns a TestClient instance for that module's FastAPI app.

methods.name: test_post_body(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST request with valid data to the '/index-weights/' endpoint, asserting a 200 response and matching JSON output.

methods.name: test_post_invalid_body(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST request with invalid data to the same endpoint, verifying validation error response with status 422.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Retrieves the OpenAPI JSON schema from the API and verifies its content.
